paragraphs.chinese:
这一集是情人节，所有人都在努力“制造浪漫”。结果当然没有一个人按计划顺利浪漫到底。

Phil 和 Claire 每年情人节都会去同一家意大利餐厅。看到 Dylan 给 Haley 准备了一个特别夸张的浪漫礼物之后，Phil 突然觉得自己和 Claire 的传统太没劲了，于是订了酒店，还提议两个人玩点角色扮演。

到了酒店酒吧，Phil 变成了来出差的商人 Clive Bixby，Claire 则扮成一个刚认识的神秘女人 Julianna。第一次尝试就翻车了，因为 Phil 明明在演陌生人，却开始吐槽自己现实里的老婆。两个人只好重来。这一次 Claire 直接玩大了：她去洗手间把裙子脱掉，只穿着一件大衣重新回来。

两个人准备上楼时，Claire 的大衣却被自动扶梯卡住了。她又不能把衣服脱掉，因为里面真的什么都没穿。于是两个人就卡在那里，而各种认识的人一个接一个走过来跟他们聊天。最后 Jay 和 Gloria 也出现了，Gloria 把自己的外套给 Claire，她才终于不用在整个酒店面前走光。

第二天早上，Phil 打电话给 Claire，兴奋地回味昨晚有多刺激。他完全没发现自己的声音正通过车里的音响播放出来，三个孩子全坐在旁边听。Claire 赶紧把电话掐掉，免得他说出更糟糕的内容。

与此同时，Jay 带 Gloria 去看一个自己喜欢了很多年的喜剧演员。Gloria 本来想去跳 salsa，可 Jay 坚信她一定会喜欢这个表演。结果喜剧演员很快就注意到两人的年龄差，开始拿 Jay 当现场素材，一遍遍调侃“老男人娶年轻老婆”。

Jay 一开始还陪着笑，后来终于受不了了，直接离场。Gloria 跟出去，Jay 才承认这些笑话真的戳到了自己。他担心自己继续变老以后，Gloria 会有一天不再想要他。Gloria 告诉他，她根本不在乎陌生人怎么看，而且自己不会离开。两个人干脆不看剩下的表演，改去跳 salsa。

Mitchell 和 Cameron 这边正在照顾 Manny。Manny 给 Fiona 写了一首情人节诗，结果另一个男孩 Ted Durkas 把诗偷走，冒充成自己写的。Manny 又不敢直接跟他对质，于是 Mitchell 和 Cameron 带他去了 Fiona 和 Durkas 正在约会的餐厅。

Mitchell 前几个月一直在准备一场非常重要的庭审发言，结果当天临时没机会讲。他把这股劲全用到了 Durkas 身上，当众一路逼问，直到 Durkas 最后承认诗是偷的。

照理说这应该是 Manny 大获全胜的时刻。结果 Fiona 反而觉得 Durkas “明明有那些感情，只是不知道怎么表达”特别甜，最后还是选择跟他在一起。

于是 Manny 没追到女孩，Mitchell 总算把那场憋了几个月的演讲讲了出来，Jay 最后跳上了舞，而 Phil 和 Claire 也过了一个绝对忘不掉的情人节。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is Valentine’s Day, and everybody is trying to make romance happen on purpose. That goes about as well as you’d expect.

Phil and Claire normally go to the same Italian restaurant every year. After seeing the huge romantic gift Dylan gives Haley, Phil decides their routine has gotten boring. He books a hotel and suggests they try some role-playing instead.

At the hotel bar, Phil becomes Clive Bixby, a businessman in town for a trade show, and Claire becomes Julianna, a mysterious woman he’s just met. Their first attempt is a disaster because Phil starts complaining about his real wife while pretending she’s someone else. They reset and try again. This time Claire fully commits: she goes to the bathroom, takes off her dress, and comes back wearing nothing but her coat.

They head upstairs, but Claire’s coat gets caught in the escalator. She can’t take it off because there’s literally nothing underneath. So the two of them are stuck there while people they know keep walking up and starting conversations. Jay and Gloria eventually arrive, and Gloria gives Claire her own coat so she can escape without flashing the entire hotel.

The next morning, Phil calls Claire to talk about how exciting the night was. He doesn’t realize his voice is playing through the car speakers while all three kids are sitting there. Claire cuts him off before the conversation gets any worse.

Meanwhile, Jay takes Gloria to see a comedian he has loved for years. Gloria wanted to go salsa dancing, but Jay is sure she’ll love the show. Then the comedian notices their age difference and starts using Jay as material, making joke after joke about an old man with a much younger wife.

Jay laughs at first, then finally walks out. Gloria follows him, and Jay admits the jokes hit a real nerve. He worries that as he gets older, Gloria may stop wanting him. Gloria tells him she doesn’t care what strangers think and she isn’t going anywhere. They skip the rest of the show and go salsa dancing instead.

Mitchell and Cameron are looking after Manny, who is having his own romantic disaster. He wrote a Valentine’s poem for Fiona, but another boy, Ted Durkas, stole it and took credit. Manny is too intimidated to confront him, so Mitchell and Cameron take him to the restaurant where Fiona and Durkas are having their date.

Mitchell has spent months preparing an important speech for court, only to lose the chance to deliver it that day. He ends up using the same fire on Durkas. He publicly calls him out until Durkas finally admits he stole the poem.

It should be Manny’s big win. Instead, Fiona thinks it’s sweet that Durkas had the feelings but didn’t know how to express them, and she stays with him.

So Manny loses the girl, Mitchell finally gets to give his speech, Jay ends up dancing, and Phil and Claire get a Valentine’s Day they definitely won’t forget.
